claims.reason: The CI_AS_KS_WS_SC_UTF8 COLLATE clause compiles in both the SELECT list and GROUP BY, which shows it is accepted in expressions.

claims.reason: The engine raised error 448 'Invalid collation' for the unknown name at compile time.

With an explicit COLLATE on one side the join compiles, so the conflict is resolved.
claims.unproven: That the chosen collation decides whether the join matches case-sensitively at run time.
